summary:
FieldShift is an intelligent agricultural decision-support web platform powered by NASA Earth observation data and generative AI.   We developed a full-stack dashboard featuring interactive parcel mapping, multi-year crop rotation planning, climate and water stress simulators, and a context-aware AI agronomic assistant. By integrating satellite datasets—specifically NASA POWER (temperature and precipitation), SMAP (soil moisture), and MODIS (NDVI vegetation health)—with local farm records, FieldShift translates complex space-based telemetry into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to each field.   
he platform directly addresses the challenge of water scarcity and climate unpredictability in agriculture by helping farmers anticipate drought conditions, optimize irrigation schedules, and transition from water-intensive monocultures to resilient crop rotations (such as alternating durum wheat with nitrogen-fixing chickpeas).
ieldShift is important because it democratizes satellite Earth observation for everyday farming. Instead of raw technical data, farmers receive plain-language insights and interactive scenario modeling, empowering them to conserve water, protect soil fertility, and secure sustainable yields one season ahead
details: FieldShift combines space-based telemetry with local farm data in a unified, interactive web dashboard:Data Processing Pipeline: A Python analytics engine (analyse.py) processes historical and seasonal precipitation and temperature datasets alongside NASA satellite feeds—NASA POWER (agro-climatology and evapotranspiration), SMAP (surface soil moisture), and MODIS (NDVI vegetation health)—structuring them into actionable JSON insights.
